0022600192.text: The Washington Wizards (4-5, 2-3 on the road, 8th in the East) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (7-2, 4-0 at home, 1st in the Northwest) in the Wizards' 10th game of the season, after Washington lost its last two games and Oklahoma City has won three straight. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Anthony Davis is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision, while Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), and Jaylin Williams is day-to-day with back spasms and a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, the Wizards lost 0-2 in 2025-26, and the most recent meeting was a 132-111 Oklahoma City win in Washington on March 21, 2026.
